pickup.title: Store pickup
pickup.subtext: Your shipping address will switch to the store address. Billing address is not changed by this extension: use checkout’s “same as shipping” or an orderUpdate Flow. We will notify you by email and SMS when ready. Hours: M-F 10:00–20:00, Sat 10:00–14:00.
pickup.addressNotConfigured: Store address is not configured in the metafield.
pickup.cannotPatchShippingAddress: In this checkout mode Shopify may block editing the shipping address (e.g. Apple/Google Pay or a checkout that locks the address). Try the normal web checkout (email + manual address).
